ai.summary: South Korea’s president sought parliamentary approval for a 2027 budget allocating 21.3 trillion won (about $16 billion) to AI and related semiconductor, physical-AI and data-center projects, nearly twice this year’s amount. This is a budget proposal, not evidence of completed spending or realized economic gains.
ai.title: South Korea’s Lee vows to make bold AI investment in record budget push

ai.summary: Argentina’s President Javier Milei is pitching Patagonia for AI data centers, citing land, energy and proposed tax incentives alongside minimal AI regulation. AP reports that major projects remain plans, with investment incentives still awaiting Senate approval; the pitch is not evidence of operating capacity.
ai.title: Argentina's Milei pitches a regulation-free AI haven at the end of the world

ai.summary: Samsung says about 50 executives met OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in Yongin on October 31 to discuss AI, business opportunities, decision-making and organizational operations. Its statement cites the companies’ earlier infrastructure memorandum as background but does not announce a new memory-supply agreement.
ai.title: Samsung hosts Sam Altman for executive AI-strategy discussion

quantum.summary: South Korea says it plans to connect its new Hangang supercomputer with a quantum computer in the first half of 2027. The proposed hybrid system is intended to combine high-performance computing and quantum processing.
quantum.title: South Korea unveils Hangang supercomputer, plans quantum integration

quantum.summary: An October 28 preprint reports a decoder that exploits correlated atom losses in simulated [[144,12,12]] Gross-code circuits. Logical error rates fell by up to about 25 times versus a loss-unaware decoder, but about two times versus a loss-aware baseline; this is not a hardware demonstration.
quantum.title: Simulation study improves loss-aware decoding for a quantum LDPC code

quantum.summary: An October 29 preprint benchmarks a neural decoder for high-rate quantum LDPC codes using simulated quantum-memory data. It reports lower amortized decoding time on an NVIDIA H200 GPU than CPU baselines; real-time single-shot operation and performance on experimental data remain next steps.
quantum.title: Neural Triage decoder reports faster simulated quantum-memory decoding

quantum.summary: An October 29 preprint treats ancillary atoms in Rydberg-array optimization embeddings as a classical error-correcting code. Its decoder recovered exact solutions on QuEra Aquila in experiments of up to 107 atoms; this is optimization-result postprocessing, not a demonstration of fault-tolerant quantum computing or commercial advantage.
quantum.title: Classical decoding improves Rydberg-array optimization experiments

quantum.summary: An October 29 theoretical preprint constructs subsystem spacetime codes to characterize distances of Clifford circuits, locate distance loss in dynamical codes and analyze circuit composition. It offers an analysis framework, not a hardware demonstration or measured operating gain.
quantum.title: Maryland preprint develops a framework for Clifford-circuit fault tolerance

quantum.summary: Quantum X Labs reports reconstructing an encrypted image with its Qatacomb scheme on an IBM Heron r2 processor. The November 2 company release describes a demonstration on a 156-qubit machine, not independently verified security, use of all 156 qubits, or IBM endorsement.
quantum.title: Quantum X Labs reports Qatacomb encryption demonstration on IBM hardware
